scheme_name: Workers In Case Of His Partial Permanent Disablement-JKBOCWWB
description:
The "Workers In Case Of His Partial Permanent Disablement" scheme is an initiative launched by the Jammu and Kashmir Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (JKBOCWWB). 

This scheme was established to provide financial assistance to construction workers who suffer from partial permanent disabilities due to accidents or injuries sustained while working. 

The scheme aims to ensure that workers receive adequate support to cope with the loss of income and to cover medical expenses arising from such disabilities. 

The JKBOCWWB was constituted under the Building and Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 1996. 

The act was enacted to regulate the employment and conditions of service of building and other construction workers. 

The scheme was officially launched on 1st January 2019. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to provide a financial safety net for workers who are partially permanently disabled. 

The scheme aims to provide a one-time financial assistance of ₹1,00,000 to eligible beneficiaries. 

This amount is intended to help cover medical expenses and provide some financial relief during the recovery period. 

The eligibility criteria for this scheme are specific and clearly defined. 

Workers must be registered with the JKBOCWWB to qualify for the benefits under this scheme. 

The minimum age for eligibility is 18 years. 

There is no upper age limit specified for the scheme. 

Workers must have been engaged in building and other construction work at the time of the accident. 

The income criteria for eligibility stipulates that the worker's monthly income should not exceed ₹15,000. 

To apply for the benefits under this scheme, workers must follow a specific application process. 

The first step is to obtain the application form from the JKBOCWWB office or download it from the official website. 

The application form must be filled out completely and accurately. 

Workers must attach relevant documents such as proof of identity, proof of registration with the board, and medical certificates detailing the nature of the disability. 

Once the application is completed, it should be submitted to the nearest JKBOCWWB office. 

The application must be submitted within 60 days of the occurrence of the accident or injury. 

After submission, the application will be reviewed by the board. 

The board will verify the details provided and may conduct an inquiry if necessary. 

Once the application is approved, the financial assistance will be disbursed. 

The disbursement is typically made within 30 days of approval. 

The funds are transferred directly to the bank account of the beneficiary. 

The scheme is implemented by the Jammu and Kashmir Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board. 

The board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Government of Jammu and Kashmir. 

For any inquiries or assistance, workers can contact the JKBOCWWB office at their headquarters in Jammu. 

The contact number for the JKBOCWWB is 0191-254-1400. 

The board also has a dedicated website where workers can find additional information and resources. 

The website is regularly updated with the latest information regarding various welfare schemes. 

The scheme has been designed to be inclusive and accessible to all registered construction workers in Jammu and Kashmir. 

The government aims to ensure that no worker is left without support in the event of a disabling injury. 

The scheme is part of a broader initiative to improve the welfare of workers in the construction sector. 

This sector is known for its high-risk nature and the potential for accidents. 

The government recognizes the need for robust support systems for workers who face such challenges. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is intended to alleviate the immediate financial burden on workers and their families. 

In addition to this scheme, the JKBOCWWB offers various other welfare measures for construction workers. 

These measures include health insurance, maternity benefits, and educational assistance for workers' children. 

The board is committed to enhancing the overall welfare of construction workers in the region. 

The implementation of this scheme has been closely monitored to ensure that benefits reach the intended beneficiaries. 

The government has also conducted awareness campaigns to inform workers about the scheme and its benefits. 

These campaigns aim to educate workers on how to apply and the importance of registration with the board. 

The JKBOCWWB has reported a steady increase in the number of applications received since the launch of the scheme. 

This indicates a growing awareness among workers regarding their rights and available support. 

The scheme is a crucial step towards providing social security to construction workers in Jammu and Kashmir. 

It reflects the government's commitment to improving the living conditions of workers in the informal sector. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme can significantly impact the lives of workers and their families. 

It helps ensure that they can access necessary medical care and maintain their livelihoods despite facing disabilities. 

The JKBOCWWB continues to work towards enhancing the welfare of construction workers through various initiatives. 

The board is dedicated to creating a safer working environment and reducing the incidence of accidents in the construction sector. 

Overall, the "Workers In Case Of His Partial Permanent Disablement" scheme is a vital component of the welfare framework for construction workers in Jammu and Kashmir. 

It provides essential support to those who need it most and contributes to the overall well-being of the workforce in the region. 

The scheme exemplifies the government's proactive approach to addressing the challenges faced by workers in high-risk occupations. 

By ensuring that workers have access to financial assistance in times of need, the government is fostering a more secure and supportive environment for all construction workers. 

This initiative is a testament to the importance of social security measures in promoting the welfare of vulnerable populations in society. 

The JKBOCWWB remains committed to continuously improving and expanding its welfare programs to meet the evolving needs of construction workers. 

The board encourages all eligible workers to register and take advantage of the benefits available under this scheme. 

Through these efforts, the government aims to build a more resilient and empowered workforce in the construction sector.
